text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Seeking the Pearl barges into my
office with gusto.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Get ready to pack your bags! It's time for
us to take on international
races!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's simple! Countless tough opponents are
waiting for me on the other
side of the sea!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's start by going to France! Bonjour,
Calvados!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pearl's been wanting to compete overseas
for a while now. Given her
skills, it
wouldn't be impossible...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But first we'd need to apply for leave
from Tracen, get approval from the URA,
register as a racer at our destination,
secure lodgings while we're there, and the
list goes on...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've already considered that! ♪ While
we're waiting, we can take in
the beautiful
gardens and air that France has to offer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep up my training over
there, it's all okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like she's been thinking about how to make good use of her time while overseas. Still, it's not like we can just pack our bags and go. Good thing I prepared that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The VR Umalator! So this is what you
meant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The VR Umalator is a simulator for
races. It
can replicate various
racecourses under
different weather conditions.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see, I can simulate racing against
international powerhouses around
the
world! Very good!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, let us start up the simulator! I'll
show you my possibilities in
virtual space!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I configure the settings and boot up the
program. I choose a French
racecourse
along with a handful of international
powerhouses.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The turf is so springy... Haha,
a perfect fit
for my feet! Time to show
off my top
speed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This long straightaway leads straight to
glory! Umamusume from
around the world!
Just try and keep up with yours truly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl leaves the other
powerhouses in the dust and
crosses the
finish line in first!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I disagree! How can you call that perfect?
Next time, let me run
alongside bison and
deer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In the past, wild animals have charged
onto the track during races overseas! It's
entirely possible that might happen in one
of my races
too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Unpredictable happenings, unexpected
troubles—you can only claim
you're
prepared once you've overcome them all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to try running in every
situation I can imagine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The overseas races Pearl describes are an
unknown domain even to
me. I doubt any
amount of preparation would fully satisfy
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But as her trainer,
it's my job to meet her
needs! For now, I'll have her
experience a
bunch of different situations.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, now that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Set the temperature to 40 degrees
Celsius! And make the turf
dried-up! Oh,
and prepare the opposite situation too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can you also make the conditions of the
simulated Umamusume
random?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! I'll leave it to you then! Next,
I'll
get ready to run in
America!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to match Pearl's enthusiasm for
training, I devote myself to
the computer.
When I look up, the sun is already up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But, Pearl is waiting for me in the gym.
I...
need... to go...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm, is Trainer running late? ...Oh,
the data
input is done!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well they've been hard at work.
More importantly, it's time to
run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the all-nighter I pulled,
Pearl is now able to experience a
plethora of
possibilities within the virtual
simulator.
